newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Port of Tauranga to develop box terminal.
newsitem.headline: Port of Tauranga to develop box terminal.

text.p: Port of Tauranga, on the east coast of New Zealand's North Island, is to update its container terminal facility to raise its service level for liner shipping clients and core forest products exporters who are increasingly using containerised shipment instead of break bulk.

In a statement on Monday the company said the terminal completion project, to include road and rail interchange, computerised container tracking and ship and bay planning systems, was expected to cost up to NZ$2.0 million.
